children.label: process_evaluation
children.description: Focuses on the implementation and operational aspects of humanitarian programs, assessing the efficiency and effectiveness of processes and procedures.

children.label: cost_effectiveness_analysis
children.description: Analyzes the cost-effectiveness of humanitarian interventions, comparing the costs of different programs to their outcomes to identify the most efficient use of resources.

children.label: participatory_evaluation
children.description: Involves the active participation of affected communities in the evaluation process, ensuring that their perspectives and needs are central to the assessment.

children.label: outcome_mapping
children.description: Maps the outcomes of humanitarian interventions to understand the changes in the lives of beneficiaries, including both direct and indirect effects.
